assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / production asset extraction. The attached selected PROMIX website mockup contains the APPROVED hero photograph in its right-hand rectangle. Extract and reproduce ONLY THAT PHOTOGRAPH as a clean standalone photographic asset. OUTPUT a portrait image 1024 x 1472. No website screenshot, no UI, no text whatsoever.

Reference photograph is the rectangle approximately x=880..1493, y=127..1007 in the supplied 1562x1007 screenshot. Preserve that photograph's exact scene and composition: one single upright wall finishing sample in three-quarter view, broad light ivory front plane extending off the left edge, its crisp top edge slanting upward to the right, the narrow vertical layered cut edge at about 66-75% across the photograph, small visible porous gray mineral substrate on the right side, dark desaturated navy studio background, matte dark stone floor, original soft directional grazing light from the upper-left and shadows. The specimen stands on the floor. Keep the same camera angle, material proportions, silhouette and lighting. Do not invent a new object or rotate the sample.

Remove ONLY the UI over the photograph: the white L-shaped corner line near the upper-left and all bottom caption text/numbers. Reconstruct the underlying dark background/floor naturally. There must be NO letters, words, numbers, corner marks, watermarks, frame or border.
The front plane must stay completely light, finely matte and impeccably finished, uniformly smooth with subtle authentic random micrograin. Do not reintroduce any gray stain, chipped patch, ragged triangle, scraped area or exposed substrate on the front, especially at the lower-right corner. The layered transition remains visible ONLY at the clean narrow right-hand cut edge. No embossed or swirling decorative pattern on the front; refined skimcoat, almost smooth. The right edge has fine natural mineral pores and neat, straight bonded strata.

Match the selected photo faithfully, as a professional architectural material specimen. Important framing: leave breathing space above the highest corner and some dark floor beneath the base for the site's existing HTML caption. No product packaging or tools.

Use case: precise-object-edit / responsive photographic reframing. The attached image is the APPROVED portrait hero photograph of a PROMIX architectural wall-finishing specimen. Create ONLY its WIDER CAMERA FRAMING for the same website's mobile hero. Output 1536x1024 landscape 3:2.

Keep the SAME SINGLE panel: exact creamy ivory light broad finished front, the thin neat bonded finishing strata at its right edge, porous gray substrate side, camera angle and upper-left illumination, soft shadow, navy studio background and dark matte floor. No redesign, no new object, no rotation, no additional layers. The face stays fully finished with absolutely NO lower-right gray patch, damage, chips, ragged triangle, stain or unfinished areas.

Pull the camera back and extend the same dark navy background and floor sideways. Compose the photograph so the complete TOP RIGHT corner and complete BOTTOM RIGHT base of the sample BOTH remain visible with comfortable dark breathing room above and below. The critical clean right-hand layered edge should sit at about 60% of total frame width, never at the far right. The large light face extends towards the left, with the left edge allowed to extend off-frame. The panel fills roughly 80% of frame height. About 15% of frame height at the bottom is calm dark floor for an HTML caption. Make the composition still clear when cropped to the central square. This is a faithful outpaint/reframe of the attached photographic scene, not a new image style.

No text, no lettering, no UI, no border, no corner marks, no watermark, no packaging, people or tools. Photorealism and physical material geometry match the reference.
